Summary

The items of #449 (reproducibility guide and adapter page) and #451 (C# limits around attributes), each checked before writing.

Type of change

  • Documentation

Changes

All EN and FR together.

  • Reproducibility guide, new subsection "When the failure is rare" (DOCS-18): meet a rare failure by rerunning the test until it fails (a shell loop over dotnet test … --filter-method), or by a throwaway seed sweep, each seed run through the seeded Any.Reproducibly, which reports the seed whatever throws (a draw, a factory, the code under test or the assertion); delete the sweep once it has named the seed, since kept it is a property test with a fixed sample.
  • Adapter page, "Replaying a failure" (XU-2): the seed replays at any level: method, class, or the assembly attribute changed. A second [assembly: Reproducible] is CS0579 (AllowMultiple = false). The optional change to the adapter's replay-line wording is not made: it is code and a probe, and the page now answers the question.
  • Adapter page (XU-3): keep a defect-revealing seed runnable on demand: [Fact(Explicit = true), Reproducible(Seed = N)], run with dotnet test --explicit only (listed by the xUnit v3 runner's --help here) or dotnet run --project Tests -- --explicit only; JD019, when enabled, still reports it, and the pin goes once the defect is fixed. The sample compiles in the documentation suite.
  • Adapter page, new section "Attribute arguments and C#" (docs: C# limits met around attributes and tuples — InlineData decimal, lone surrogates, CS8619 #451, DOCS-41 and DOCS-42): a decimal cannot be an attribute constant (CS0182), so pass a string, which xUnit v3 converts; a lone surrogate in an attribute string reaches the test as U+FFFD, since attribute arguments are stored as UTF-8. DOCS-43 (CS8619 on a tuple built in As) is left out, as the issue records: C# behaviour, and its repro does not reproduce.
  • Changelogs: the guide part under Documentation in JustDummies/CHANGELOG.md; the adapter-page part in JustDummies.Xunit/CHANGELOG.md, a new Documentation section under Unreleased, since that page ships with the adapter.

Testing

  • dotnet test --project JustDummies.Documentation.UnitTests: 20/20 passed locally (sample compilation, links, EN/FR parity).
  • dotnet test --project JustDummies.Xunit.UnitTests --help: confirms the runner's --explicit on|off|only option.

No code changed, so no other suite was run.

Documentation

  • Every page EN/FR updated together.

Architecture decisions

None.

Related issues

Closes #449
Closes #451

Contributor agreement

  • I have read the Contributor Agreement and, if I am not the Project Owner (@Reefact), I accept it for this contribution.
